title: Evaluating the Zero-shot Robustness of Instruction-tuned Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot and few-shot multiple-choice question answering accuracy on the BBQ (Bias Benchmark for QA) dataset under varying instruction phrasings to see how instruction robustness affects aggregate social bias measurement. The benchmark covers age, disability, gender, nationality, physical appearance, race/ethnicity, religion, social status, and sexual orientation, though the paper evaluates them in aggregate.
